ruleset.name: nitpicker-main-rules

rule.name: ExhaustiveEnumPredicate
rule.message: These comparisons list only some constants of an enum of the project, so a constant added later silently falls into the other case. Classify every constant: a switch expression without default (adding a constant then fails to compile), or a boolean each constant declares (PAID(true)).

rule.name: StaticForwardingWrapper
rule.message: This static method only passes its parameters, in order, to another method. Call that method directly where this one is used and delete the wrapper. Factories named of or from and copies such as List.copyOf are allowed.

rule.name: SingularAndPluralMember
rule.message: A member and its plural (tag and tags) are two ways to pass the same data. Keep the plural and pass one item as a one-element list.

rule.name: UnboundedFanOut
rule.message: This loop or stream starts a remote or message call on a new task for every element of a collection at once, so a large collection exhausts the connections or rate limit of the remote service. Run the tasks on a fixed pool (Executors.newFixedThreadPool(8) passed to supplyAsync or used for submit), take a Semaphore permit around each call, or work through fixed-size batches (Lists.partition(items, 20)). An exception fits only when the collection is always small.

rule.name: ClassLoadEffect
rule.message: Do this work in a method that main or the framework calls after startup (a @Bean method, an ApplicationRunner) and pass the result in, or create it on first use in a lazy holder class: this call runs while its class loads (in a static field or block, an enum constant, the constructor or initializer of an instance created at load, or a method one of them calls), so it connects, starts threads, sleeps or touches files in whatever order classes load, and in every test that touches the class. Constants, loggers, Pattern.compile and collections can stay static, and the class with main is not checked.

rule.name: TriStateBoolean
rule.message: A boxed Boolean can be true, false or null, so this has three states that the type does not name. Use an enum that names each state (Mode.ON, Mode.OFF, Mode.AUTO), or a primitive boolean when absence means nothing.

rule.name: ParameterMutation
rule.message: This changes the collection, map or array the caller passed in. Build and return a new one (List.copyOf, a stream, new ArrayList<>(items) filled and returned), or copy the parameter first and change the copy.

rule.name: CompatibilityShim
rule.message: A @Deprecated declaration keeps the old API next to its replacement. Delete it and change its callers to the replacement in the same change.

rule.name: LegacyCalendarApi
rule.message: Calendar.getInstance() and new GregorianCalendar() without a time zone, and new SimpleDateFormat(...) without setTimeZone, read the default time zone and are not thread-safe. Use java.time with an explicit zone: Instant, or ZonedDateTime.now(clock), and a DateTimeFormatter with withZone(zone). Passing a TimeZone to Calendar.getInstance or the GregorianCalendar constructor is allowed.
